approved_by: User instruction, 25 October 2026: agricultural specialisation additionally reduces agricultural workforce requirements, including the subsistence sector in low-GDP-per-capita countries.

source_evidence.commercial: common/scripted_effects/00_money_system.txt:5659, agriculture_district_worker_requirement_modifier scales workers_per_agriculture_district with a native 0.10 floor.
source_evidence.subsistence: common/scripted_effects/mdcw_imperia_gdp_balance_effects.txt:52, agriculture_workers_modifier scales the productivity-dependent subsistence employment fraction.
source_evidence.scope: These are sector labour requirements, not total-workforce size. Released labour can enter other available work. Native subsistence GDP also depends on workers, so existing productivity rewards matter.

special_agriculture_mandate.description_insert: Common machinery, storage and technical services will reduce the labour required in agricultural districts and subsistence farming.

special_agriculture_left_follow.description_insert: Mechanised harvesting will release workers from both commercial fields and subsistence production, with the largest savings in the organised districts.

special_agriculture_right_follow.description_insert: Shared equipment and coordinated work will reduce labour requirements in both agricultural districts and subsistence farming.
